title: "Project Repository"
page-layout: full
---

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false

library(readr)
library(htmltools)

projects <- read_csv("data/projects.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

make_card <- function(row) {
  searchable <- paste(
    row$project_id, row$title, row$short_title, row$description, row$status,
    row$peers, row$topics, row$paper_titles, row$code_keywords, row$video_titles,
    row$search_keywords, row$papers_md, row$code_md, row$videos_md, row$peers_md,
    row$project_page,
    collapse = " "
  )

  topic_chips <- strsplit(row$topics, ";")[[1]]
  topic_chips <- trimws(topic_chips)

  tags$article(
    class = "project-card",
    `data-search` = tolower(searchable),
    tags$div(
      class = "card-topline",
      tags$span(class = "project-id", row$project_id),
      tags$span(class = paste("status-badge", tolower(gsub(" ", "-", row$status))), row$status)
    ),
    tags$h3(row$short_title),
    tags$p(class = "card-title-full", row$title),
    tags$p(class = "project-desc", row$description),
    tags$div(
      class = "chip-row",
      lapply(topic_chips[seq_len(min(length(topic_chips), 4))], function(x) tags$span(class = "chip", x))
    ),
    tags$p(class = "project-meta", tags$strong("Peers: "), row$peers),
    tags$details(
      class = "search-details",
      tags$summary("Searchable details"),
      tags$p(tags$strong("Papers: "), row$paper_titles),
      tags$p(tags$strong("Code: "), row$code_keywords),
      tags$p(tags$strong("Videos: "), row$video_titles),
      tags$p(tags$strong("Keywords: "), row$search_keywords)
    ),
    tags$div(
      class = "project-links",
      tags$a(href = row$project_page, "Overview"),
      tags$a(href = row$peers_md, "Peers"),
      tags$a(href = row$papers_md, "Papers"),
      tags$a(href = row$code_md, "Code"),
      tags$a(href = row$videos_md, "Videos")
    )
  )
}

n_projects <- nrow(projects)
n_active <- sum(projects$status == "Active", na.rm = TRUE)
n_topics <- length(unique(unlist(strsplit(paste(projects$topics, collapse = ";"), ";"))))

tagList(
  tags$section(
    class = "hero",
    tags$div(
      class = "hero-bg-glow"
    ),
    tags$div(
      class = "hero-inner",
      tags$p(class = "hero-kicker", "GitHub Pages · Quarto · Searchable project catalog"),
      tags$h1("A cleaner home for project resources"),
      tags$p(
        class = "hero-subtitle",
        "Search across projects, peers, papers, code, videos, and keywords from a single GitHub-hosted site."
      ),
      tags$div(
        class = "hero-actions",
        tags$a(class = "hero-button primary", href = "#search", "Search projects"),
        tags$a(class = "hero-button secondary", href = "projects.html", "Browse all projects")
      ),
      tags$div(
        class = "stats-row",
        tags$div(class = "stat-card", tags$span(n_projects), tags$p("Projects")),
        tags$div(class = "stat-card", tags$span(n_active), tags$p("Active")),
        tags$div(class = "stat-card", tags$span(n_topics), tags$p("Topic labels"))
      )
    )
  ),

  tags$main(
    class = "site-main",
    tags$section(
      id = "search",
      class = "search-panel",
      tags$div(
        class = "search-header",
        tags$div(
          tags$p(class = "section-kicker", "Search"),
          tags$h2("Find the right project resource")
        ),
        tags$p(class = "search-note", "Search uses project metadata in data/projects.csv.")
      ),
      tags$input(
        id = "projectSearch",
        class = "search-input",
        type = "text",
        placeholder = "Try: PLINK, Olink, heritability, MRI, peer name, paper title, video title..."
      ),
      tags$div(
        class = "quick-filter-row",
        tags$button(class = "quick-filter", `data-term` = "", "All"),
        tags$button(class = "quick-filter", `data-term` = "active", "Active"),
        tags$button(class = "quick-filter", `data-term` = "genetics", "Genetics"),
        tags$button(class = "quick-filter", `data-term` = "proteomics", "Proteomics"),
        tags$button(class = "quick-filter", `data-term` = "heritability", "Heritability"),
        tags$button(class = "quick-filter", `data-term` = "MRI", "MRI")
      ),
      tags$p(id = "resultCount", class = "result-count")
    ),

    tags$section(
      class = "project-grid",
      lapply(seq_len(nrow(projects)), function(i) make_card(projects[i, ]))
    )
  ),

  tags$script(HTML("
    const input = document.getElementById('projectSearch');
    const cards = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.project-card'));
    const resultCount = document.getElementById('resultCount');
    const buttons = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('.quick-filter'));

    function updateCards() {
      const q = input.value.toLowerCase().trim();
      let visible = 0;

      cards.forEach(card => {
        const text = card.dataset.search;
        const show = text.includes(q);
        card.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
        if (show) visible += 1;
      });

      resultCount.textContent = `${visible} project(s) shown`;
    }

    buttons.forEach(btn => {
      btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
        input.value = btn.dataset.term;
        updateCards();
        input.focus();
      });
    });

    input.addEventListener('input', updateCards);
    updateCards();
  "))
)
```
